h: US withdraws from U-17 World Cup in Qatar over security concerns
p: The United States has pulled its team out of the FIFA U-17 World Cup in Qatar, citing a State Department travel advisory linked to the situation in the Middle East. The tournament starts on 19 November.
body: The United States has withdrawn from the FIFA Under-17 World Cup in Qatar because of security concerns.

In a letter to players and staff, reported on Wednesday, 11 November 2026, US Soccer said it had cancelled the team's pre-tournament camp and would no longer take part, citing a State Department travel advisory that places Qatar at Level 3, urging Americans to reconsider travel because of the risk of armed conflict in the region. The federation said the well-being of its players and staff was its top priority.

The tournament is due to begin on 19 November, just over a week after the announcement. It was not immediately clear how FIFA would replace the US team. Nigeria's under-17 women's team, the Flamingos, recently won the women's edition of the tournament in Morocco.
more: US Soccer cited a Level 3 travel advisory.
FIFA has not said how the US will be replaced.
